Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-chokotto-tenranzan/

Notice the small changes in nature you might miss on a regular walk. Join a guide as you explore Tenranzan on this short, easy-to-enjoy tour. Everyone welcome!

【Fee】
¥2,000 per person; ¥1,500 for repeat visitors; ¥4,000 per family (includes guide and insurance)

【Capacity】
10 people

【Guide】
Tsubasa Kojima (Hanno City Eco-Tourism Citizen Guides Association, Living Things Group)

【What to bring】
Drink, rain gear, backpack or similar (something that leaves your hands free is recommended), towel, insect repellent spray
location: 集合 飯能市立博物館前（国際興業バス「OH!!!・天覧山下」または「市民会館・博物館」バス停下車徒歩3分）
